purpose: Reverse pending receiver history: NEXT returns NULL without copying the reference cache or overwriting its LIVE input; later row COW separates the input-owned old array.

<?php

class ReviewBufferedNextNew36 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewBufferedNextChild36() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewBufferedNextOld36()]; echo "C|"; try { $received = yield 7 => $row; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedNextLower36() { echo "L|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedNextUpper36() { echo "U|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedNextTop36() { echo "T|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-TOP|"; } finally { echo "V|"; } }
function reviewBufferedNextOuter36() { echo "O|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["top"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$injected = new Exception("buffered-next36"); $child = reviewBufferedNextChild36(); $lower = reviewBufferedNextLower36(); $upper = reviewBufferedNextUpper36(); $top = reviewBufferedNextTop36(); $outer = reviewBufferedNextOuter36();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|"; $lower->send($row); echo "S|THROW|";
try { $top->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "N|"; $void = $upper->next(); echo "RET|", $void === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedNextOld36 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$row[0] = new ReviewBufferedNextNew36(); echo "COW|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedNextNew36 ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caught, $injected); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($top); echo "TOP|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|"; unset($row, $void); echo "ROW|"; echo "E";
